audience: Malaysian businesses that keep their accounts in Bukku and want help with invoices, bills and contacts

useCases.title: Chase overdue sales invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices that are outstanding or overdue with balances, and looks up the customer behind each one.

useCases.title: Review supplier bills
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase bills by date, supplier or payment status, and opens any bill with its lines, taxes and payments.

useCases.title: Draft a sales invoice
useCases.text: The AI looks up the customer, accounts and tax codes, then creates a sales invoice, as a draft unless you ask for it to be finalized.

useCases.title: Add a customer or supplier
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact with a unique code, and archives or restores a contact when you ask. Nothing is deleted.

useCases.title: Review bank activity
useCases.text: The AI lists money in, money out and transfers, and opens one transaction in full, so you can check your bank records.

useCases.title: Browse accounts and journals
useCases.text: The AI lists the chart of accounts and the manual journal entries of a period, with their debit and credit lines.
